gear.name: Acolyte Robes
gear.description: Bits of robes and undergarments from the dedicated Acolytes, just as modest as the lives they lead.

gear.name: Armored Rags
gear.description:
A sorry bunch of rags with some improvised armored plating strapped to them. Better than nothing, but not enough to stop a bullet.

Many scavengers and highwaymen start off their careers with this sort of scrapped-together attire.

gear.name: Ashen Ushanka
gear.description:
A very common piece of headwear throughout Zalesye, and one of the first trades people make when they come into some money.

Its comfy shape and texture are great against the cold, but don't offer much protection.

gear.name: Balistic Kask
gear.description: One of the most common pieces of Pre-War soldier equipment, this cheaply mass-produced helmet is sturdy enough against bludgeon attacks, but will not stop a bullet.

gear.name: Bandit Duds
gear.description: A set of clothes from local Bandits. Surprisingly appropriate for running around and shooting people.

gear.name: Binoculars
gear.description: A pair of well-made, pre-War binoculars that have resisted the years. The casing is banged up, but the lenses have been preserved.

gear.name: Brown Rags
gear.description:
Filthy old rags worn by most Commonfolk of Zalesye.

A reminder that, even after the apocalypse, there's no time wasted in finding the lowest common denominator.

gear.name: Chest Patch
gear.description:
A bloody chest patch that could have been given out by folks at the Hospital, or could be homemade.

The only protection it offers is to stop a wound that's already bleeding.

gear.name: Common Backpack
gear.description: A brown backpack made of leather and nylon, relatively comfortable and durable.

gear.name: Commonfolk Rags
gear.description: A bundle of rags worn by the common men and women of Zalesye. The low quality cloth makes them even more vulnerable than they already are.

gear.name: Dusty Overcoat
gear.description:
A reliable dust coat is an important part of a Scavenger’s attire, since it protects against the unpredictable weather, dust and debris of the areas near the Thresholds.

Although there is not much variety to be found in this category, it’s still very important to keep one’s dust coat relatively clean and in one piece.

gear.name: Ekzoskelet Armor
gear.description: A Mechanist's bold creation, weaving metal parts in and out of a regular, weathered blouse. They offer great resistance without sacrificing stamina.

gear.name: Ekzoskelet Legs
gear.description:
A Mechanist's bizarre invention, the Ekzoskelet Legs are a heavy-duty lining of metal parts woven together with regular trousers.

They're designed to offer great resistance and to actually improve the wearer's stamina, but they're still very clumsy to use.

gear.name: GP-4 Gas Mask
gear.description:
This widespread Gas Mask was issued to Civil Defense and civilians alike, during the times of War. 

Vultures and Bandits often wear these for days at a time, and the mask’s straps dig themselves painfully into the back of their heads.

gear.name: Green Rags
gear.description:
A bunch of dirty rags, dyed green at a distant point in time; they offer no protection and very little warmth.

These clothes might be valued solely for their extra bit of color. Those who want to stand out for whatever reason may resort to something like this.

gear.name: Gunner Apparel
gear.description: Pieces of Gunner clothing, designed to be resistant, flexible and intimidating.

gear.name: Head Patch
gear.description:
A bloody head patch that could have been given out by folks at the Hospital, or could be homemade.

It barely retains any warmth, offers no protection, and gives off a rotten stink.

gear.name: Leg Patch
gear.description:
A bloody leg patch that could have been given out by folks at the Hospital, or could be homemade.

There's not much to be gained from wearing this if your wounds are already healed.

gear.name: Mechanist Workwear
gear.description: Greasy clothes from an industrious Mechanist, in decent condition.

gear.name: Metal Breastplate
gear.description:
A heavy and effective metal breasplate fitted onto good-quality cloth. Provides good defense at the cost of some mobility.

This much metal on a piece of armor is better worn hidden under a coat of some sort; otherwise, the wearer becomes a shiny, walking target.

gear.name: Mudlark Tatters
gear.description: Shoddy garments from a corpse-bearer, carrying the scent of death through Zalesye.

gear.name: Old Blue Trousers
gear.description:
A pair of old trousers adorned with crusty stains and accompanied by a strong smell.

The material is reasonably resistant and won't break apart too easily.

gear.name: Old GP-4 Gas Mask
gear.description:
This widespread Gas Mask was issued to Civil Defense and civilians alike, during the times of War. 

Vultures and Bandits often wear these for days at a time, and the mask’s straps dig themselves painfully into the back of their heads.

This one is on the brink of shattering completely, rendering it mostly ineffective.

gear.name: Old Kepka
gear.description:
An old relic of pre-War times, when caps like this were fashionable among students and workers alike.

This one is very beat-up and on the cusp of dissolving into thin air, but still offers some warmth.

gear.name: Old Tactical Pants
gear.description: A pair of beat-up tactical pants worn by the armed men of pre-War times. Offers great mobility and is pretty comfortable, but doesn't protect against the rocky terrain of the wastes.

gear.name: Old Tactical Vest
gear.description:
A beat-up tactical vest worn by police forces of pre-Mist times. It offers great mobility and decent protection against weaker types of weapon fire.

This vest is usually a reward for those with basic training and experience in the field.

gear.name: Palatine Uniform
gear.description: Bits of a standard-issue Palatine uniform, modeled after the War heroes of old.

gear.name: Panskiy Kask
gear.description:
An old aviator's helmet, with stellar wind protection and decent resistance against impact.

However, it's a bit uncomfortable to wear all day long, and it dulls the senses a bit - not ideal for the field.

gear.name: Parade Helmet
gear.description: A high-quality steel helmet, mass-produced during the War. A red star was painted on it at some point; anyone who would've known what it means is long gone.

gear.name: Patched Armored Blouse
gear.description:
A decayed padding meant to be fastened and worn on top of one’s shirt, consisting of bits and pieces of ceramic and ballistic nylon, strung together haphazardly. 

This abomination of a vest could only take a couple shots before becoming completely useless.

gear.name: Patched Pants
gear.description:
Old, raggedy pants, held together by haphazard patches. They offer some warmth where there aren't any holes.

Even sitting in the rubble of Zalesye will hurt your legs when all you have is this.

gear.name: Plated Overcoat
gear.description: A quality overcoat with some extra armor plating on the shoulder. The preferred gear for most scavengers, as it's very resistant to weather and the mud and grime of Zalesye.

gear.name: Plated Ragged Pants
gear.description: A pair of blue pants with defensive platings, tactical pouches and worn out cuffs. A bit difficult to move around in, but sturdy enough.

gear.name: Rada Outfit
gear.description: Clothes from a working Rada member, stained with sweat from hard work at the farms.

gear.name: Rain Coat
gear.description: An old, discarded rain coat that can offer plenty of protection from the constant rains of Zalesye, at the cost of providing very little warmth.

gear.name: Refurbished Kask
gear.description: A refurbished helmet from the War, unbalanced and clunky but with decent protection against impact and, with luck, capable of resisting a couple of bullets.

gear.name: Reinforced Leather Pants
gear.description:
A creased pair of leather pants with bits of scrap metal sewn into the knees.
Useful for the ever-kneeling scavengers as they search for more comfortable armor.

gear.name: Revolutionary Kepka
gear.description:
An old relic of pre-War times, when caps like this were fashionable among students and workers alike.

The pristine condition of this cap is a testament to the strength of ideals that are lost on you.

gear.name: Riot Vest
gear.description: This extra-sturdy, plated armor seems good enough to hold back a crowd of people, and even withstand some fire. It is heavy and difficult to wear, but survival is worth a little struggle.

gear.name: Ruined Beret
gear.description:
Once a classy beret worn by the upper ranks of the pre-War military, now a repulsive piece of headwear that is barely holding together.

A good fit for Zalesye.

gear.name: Scrapyard Armor
gear.description:
A large piece of armor plating strapped onto good-quality clothes, offering a mix of warmth and protection.

A reasonable balance between defense and mobility for those with a low budget.

gear.name: Scrapyard Pants
gear.description: A pair of old pants that's been fitted with armor platings and readjusted to prevent it from falling apart. Offers decent protection.

gear.name: Security Helmet
gear.description: A reinforced metal helmet with an armored visor, designed for heavy-duty security work. Offers great protection, but is exhaustive to wear for long periods.

gear.name: Skull Mask
gear.description: A menacing mask in the shape of a skull, worn by different folks for different reasons: some in respect and awe of the dead, others in order to intimidate and scare.

gear.name: Stronghold Vest
gear.description:
A souped-up tactical vest, with shoulder guards and bits of metal woven in throughout the fabric. Offers good protection from weaker weapons, at the cost of mobility.

This combat-oriented vest is usually worn by those have proven themselves capable.

gear.name: Vozhd Beret
gear.description:
A classy beret meant to be casually worn by the upper ranks of the pre-War military.

Its dignity and style is unlikely to be conveyed in the muddy pits of the Mire.

gear.name: Vulture Wear
gear.description: Clothes from a Vulture. You have to scrap the mud off to feel the cloth.

gear.name: Winter Pants
gear.description: A pair of thick, ragged pants with numerous patches; made by survivalists who don't mind a little extra sweat.

attachments.name: Zavod Wood Stock

attachments.name: Zavod Wrapped Stock

attachments.name: Zavod Wrapped Wood Handguard
attachments.description: A wrapped wood handguard for an over-under shotgun.

consumables.name: AI-2 Army Medkit
consumables.description: An advanced, pre-War army-issued medkit designed to deal with some pretty bad injuries.

consumables.name: AI-2 Mechanist Medkit
consumables.description: A very high-grade medkit adapted by Mechanists to reflect all of their unique knowledge. Especially regarding sedatives.

consumables.name: AI-2 Medkit
consumables.description:
This war-proven medkit has outlived both its owner and their country.

Can’t shake the feeling that I shouldn’t use it lightly.

consumables.name: Advanced Bandage
consumables.description: High-quality Esmarch bandages from a well-maintained, pre-War kit.

consumables.name: Antidote
consumables.description:
This antidote can help with venomous bites and scratches from all sorts of Mutants in Zalesye.

A wonderful concoction created by Mechanists and supplied by Acolytes.

consumables.name: Bandage
consumables.description:
These tattered bandages look like they’ll infect my wounds rather than protect them.

Still, it’s better than nothing – and I’ve used worse.

consumables.name: Beans Soup
consumables.description:
A very tasty (and expensive) soup made from beans, berries and meat.

The stew is so thick that I’m more than full by the time I finish eating. Makes me drowsy.

consumables.name: Berry Puree
consumables.description:
Mudlarks created this dish that only a few merchants dared taste.

They believe it enhances one’s awareness of the Mist...

consumables.name: Bread
consumables.description:
This bread is hard on the teeth and it tastes like ashy mold.

I power through each slice because I know it gives me energy.

consumables.name: Butter
consumables.description: A great condiment which goes with any meal. Hard to make, rare to come by, and it goes bad pretty fast.

consumables.name: Can Of Tuna
consumables.description:
This canned tuna meat has a suspiciously distant expiration date.

Good for me. It’s one of the tastier and most energy-filled rations out there.

consumables.name: Canned Beans
consumables.description:
These canned beans are the slop that’s kept me alive all these years.

Can’t even smell or taste them anymore, but they get me through the day.

consumables.name: Canteen
consumables.description:
The water around here has a taste. The implication isn’t good.

I should drink this in small swigs throughout the day – lessen the risk of radiation poisoning.

consumables.name: Cigarettes
consumables.description:
A time-tested drug which at once relaxes and keeps us alert.

Not even the Mist can prevent a Vulture from taking these out in the middle of a scavenge.

consumables.name: Currant Berries
consumables.description:
These berries are a common find in every region I’ve traveled.

They grow even in areas full of Mist, but how this affects the fruit, I don’t know.

consumables.name: Dried Mushrooms
consumables.description:
These dried mushrooms are specially prepared to give psychoactive effects.

They’ve been dulled by age, but I should still be careful when I eat this.

consumables.name: Dried Steak
consumables.description:
While I think I could find rocks that are juicier than this, the nutrition here is undeniable.

Just gotta make sure I have the time when I take this out to chew it.

consumables.name: Echelon - Cherry Lime Landmine
consumables.description:
A tasty drink to get your mind off the horrors all around!
Gives a performance boost too. Now, where to find some more?

consumables.name: Echelon - Killer Apple
consumables.description:
A drink so tasty it makes you forget about the surrounding hellscape!
Well... That didn't last long. Time for some more.

consumables.name: Fish Soup
consumables.description:
An eccentric fish soup that’s definitely an acquired taste.

The secret is to cook it for so long that it’s almost not radioactive at all.

consumables.name: Fresh Cheese
consumables.description:
A luxury food found throughout Zalesye. Great taste, not much nutrition.

I enjoy cheese more than other people seem to. Makes me almost emotional.

consumables.name: Fresh Mushrooms
consumables.description:
Fresh mushrooms with little to no radiation. Tasty, chewy and nutritious – a rare find.

These mushrooms can have drug-like effects when properly dried.

consumables.name: Headache Pills
consumables.description:
A pre-War drug for headaches and nausea... Stuff with no apparent cause.

Has broader applications nowadays.

consumables.name: IFAK Medkit
consumables.description: A mixture of many medical items found in the wasteland, all in one package.

consumables.name: Large Pumpkin
consumables.description:
A huge lunk of food which tastes and smells sweet. Usually painstakingly grown by more experienced farmers.

Big enough to make about 3 meals, as long as I can carry it around.

consumables.name: Meat Drumstick
consumables.description:
A piece of meat, straight from the bone. Tasty enough, but not ideal for health.

One of the most common ways to eat meat in Zalesye.

consumables.name: Meat Skewer
consumables.description:
The secret of making this delicious skewer is to undercook the meat, keeping it very tender.

This does, however, mean the radiation’s still in there.

consumables.name: Medicinal Herb
consumables.description:
A medicinal herb commonly used in Zalesye.

Some of its supposed uses are sketchy, but tradition makes us toss 'em in the pot anyway.

consumables.name: Moldy Cheese
consumables.description:
A piece of cheese that’s been left uneaten for too long. Smells foul, but one can acquire a taste for it.

On the edge of “experimental” and “poisonous” – but I am experienced enough to appreciate it.

consumables.name: Moonshine
consumables.description:
Locally brewed alcohol in a repurposed bottle that used to store real vodka.

Most of the drunks around here will take what they can get.

consumables.name: Morphine
consumables.description:
A pre-War drug, expertly made by medical scientists for numbing pain. A rare find.

Acolytes would love to get their hands on this, but I've heard it's addictive.

consumables.name: Mutant Steak
consumables.description: Only the desperate would eat this piece of irradiated meat before properly cooking or processing it.

consumables.name: Mystery Pills
consumables.description:
A prewar drug with half of a complicated name written in the back.

Whatever it is makes the pain go away.

consumables.name: Old Canteen
consumables.description: An old and rusty canteen. Contains a bit of dirty water inside. Probably radioactive...

consumables.name: Overripe Potato
consumables.description:
A potato with a growth already sprouting out. Not much benefit, but better than nothing.

Could still be cooked, but probably not traded.

consumables.name: Pills
consumables.description: Largely distributed within Rhos in the beginning of the end, this can treat small doses of radiation poisoning and even heal some wounds

consumables.name: Rabbit Meat
consumables.description: Gamey meat with not much succulence. Still, less irradiated and repugnant than other mutant meats.

consumables.name: Radish
consumables.description:
A spicy and crispy vegetable which survives the Mist reasonably well.

It’s very hard to find produce in Zalesye, but when I do, it’s usually this.

consumables.name: Rat Meat
consumables.description: Skewered meat from a Mora rat or two; a meager meal if ever there was one, and filthy to boot.

consumables.name: Russet Potato
consumables.description:
A common food throughout the Continent. Bland, but nutritious.

Hard to eat uncooked. Better off trading these, or having someone prepare them.

consumables.name: Salt
consumables.description: Salt: the lifeblood of any meal. Chefs who don't use it in their cooking will all be lynched by angry mobs eventually.

consumables.name: Sardines
consumables.description:
The best military ration there is – even if it’s a bit too fermented.

The salty taste makes me thirsty.

consumables.name: Snake Egg
consumables.description:
A slimy egg from a mutant snake, which can be cooked or eaten raw in moments of desperation.

I cannot attest to how nutritious this thing could be.

consumables.name: Splint
consumables.description: A medical splint, used to help the injured get around without moving their healing bones.

consumables.name: Spoiled Radish
consumables.description:
A slightly nutritious piece of spoiled produce. Makes me sick; should eat in desperate situations only.

Radish survives so well in the Mist that folks who don’t know how to grow them still try it. The result is a bunch of waste.

consumables.name: Stimpack
consumables.description: A complex mixture of drugs which can be quickly injected and discarded to numb pain, increase adrenaline and get me out of desperate situations.

consumables.name: Vegetable Soup
consumables.description:
A surprisingly good soup made from many vegetables, slowly cooked.

One of the heartier meals one can get in Zalesye without risk of radiation sickness.

consumables.name: Veles T-Bone Steak
consumables.description:
A hefty cut of meat from Veles' hindquarters. Rich in protein and marbled with fat, it's a rare delicacy in the wasteland.

Consuming it restores significant energy, but the lingering taste of the wild might not be for everyone.

consumables.name: Whole Roasted Fish
consumables.description:
The sharp crackle of fish bones against my teeth keeps me on edge, but does nothing for nutrition.

This thing came from the dirty waters of Lake Pavlie. I should eat these sparingly.

consumables.name: Worm Meat
consumables.description: Gooey and surprisingly elastic worm meat. Have to chew for hours and hours. So much fun.

crafting.description: This shows me how to make a ramrod for cleaning guns and such.

crafting.name: IFAK Medkit Blueprint

crafting.name: Meat Skewer Blueprint
crafting.description: This should teach me to make Meat Skewers.

crafting.name: Medium Armor Repair Kit Blueprint

crafting.name: Medved Grip Blueprint
crafting.description: This should teach me to craft a Medved Monster Grip.

crafting.name: Medved Handguard Blueprint
crafting.description: This should teach me to craft a Medved Monster Handguard.

crafting.name: Medved Magazine Blueprint
crafting.description: This should teach me to craft a Medved Monster Magazine.

crafting.name: Medved Monster Blueprint
crafting.description: This should teach me to craft a Medved Monster.

crafting.name: Medved Stock Blueprint
crafting.description: This should teach me to craft a Medved Monster Stock.

crafting.name: Moonshine Blueprint
crafting.description: This right here'll teach me how to make moonshine. Hope I don't mess this up, or I could go blind.

crafting.name: Morphine Blueprint
crafting.description: This blueprint teaches how to make morphine, which can help deal with all the pains that Zalesye has to offer.

crafting.name: Scavenger Armor Repair Kit Blueprint
crafting.description: This is for learning how to put together a basic, but reliable armor repair kit.

crafting.name: Scrap Gun Repair Kit Blueprint
crafting.description: This is for learning how to put together a repair kit for certain types of weapons. Good for survival.

crafting.name: Sewing Kit Blueprint
crafting.description: With this, I can learn how to make my own sewing kit for small repairs in clothing and armor.

crafting.name: Stimpack Blueprint
crafting.description: This shows how to concoct a mixture from medicinal ingredients, which can then be quickly injected.

crafting.name: Tattered Armor Repair Kit Blueprint
crafting.description: This blueprint can teach me how to put together some tools for repairing some very tattered clothes. Better than nothing...

This legendary rifle is a slow but accurate 5-shot medium- and long-distance weapon, favored by the patient and strategic.

This is the Full Stock model, with better handling and accuracy.

This is the stockless model.

items.name: 63 Dragoon
items.description:
This semi-automatic marksman rifle is designed to operate at the limit of the range one can see within the Mist.

As such, only the most calculating and patient Scavengers use this weapon – and they often have a spotter.

items.name: AI-2 Army Medkit
items.description: An advanced, pre-War army-issued medkit designed to deal with some pretty bad injuries.

items.name: AI-2 Army Medkit Blueprint

This war-proven medkit has outlived both its owner and their country.

items.name: AI-2 Medkit Blueprint
items.description: This shows a way of putting together a very effective, potentially life-saving medkit.

items.name: Acid Gland
items.description:
A fluid-filled sac that bursts on impact, spilling a burning slime used by Woundworts to dissolve aggressors.
Handle with care — or don’t handle at all.

items.name: Acolyte Robes
items.description: Bits of robes and undergarments from the dedicated Acolytes, just as modest as the lives they lead.

items.name: Acolyte Supplies
items.description: A stash of supplies that an Acolyte must've been carrying somewhere.

items.name: Acolyte's Gospel
items.description: A pre-War pocket gospel book, containing texts which are apparently very important for Acolytes and their Church.

items.name: Advanced Bandage
items.description: High-quality Esmarch bandages from a well-maintained, pre-War kit.

items.name: Advanced Bandage Blueprint
items.description: With this, I can learn to make high-quality Esmarch bandages.

items.name: Advanced Electrical Components
items.description: Complex interior parts of pre-War equipment. Can't even begin to figure this out.

items.name: Advanced Gun Repair Kit
items.description: A case of pro-grade tools for repairing any weapon from any state. Worth a lot.

items.name: Advanced Gun Repair Kit Blueprint
items.description: This lets me learn to set up a high-quality kit for maintaining and repairing weapons very reliably.

items.name: Advanced Mechanical Components
items.description: A set of gears, levers and other high-grade machine parts. Possibly good for reuse instead of recycling.

items.name: Ammo Casings
items.description: Spent ammo casings, with burns and scratches that echo someone else's battles.

items.name: Angled Foregrip
items.description: An angled foregrip designed to give a balance between stability and ergonomy.

items.name: Antidote
items.description:
This antidote can help with venomous bites and scratches from all sorts of Mutants in Zalesye.

A wonderful concoction created by Mechanists and supplied by Acolytes.

items.name: Antique Pocket Compass
items.description: A pre-War compass which seems valuable... But after all this time and Mist, I wouldn't trust it to actually point North.

items.name: Armor Plate
items.description:
A rusty plate of armor which can be strapped to one's chest, offering minimal protection in combat.

If it stops even one bullet, that's already good enough.

items.name: Armored Rags
items.description:
A sorry bunch of rags with some improvised armored plating strapped to them. Better than nothing, but not enough to stop a bullet.

Many scavengers and highwaymen start off their careers with this sort of scrapped-together attire.

items.name: Ashen Ushanka
items.description:
A very common piece of headwear throughout Zalesye, and one of the first trades people make when they come into some money.

Its comfy shape and texture are great against the cold, but don't offer much protection.

items.name: Bahadir 918 (Long)
items.description: A tactical submachine gun with reduced recoil, a high rate of fire and an unusual magazine which is tricky to reload. Perfect for kicking down the few doors still standing in Zalesye.

items.name: Bahadir 918 (Short)
items.description: A tactical submachine gun with reduced recoil, a high rate of fire, and an unusual magazine which is tricky to reload. Perfect for kicking down the few doors still standing in Zalesye.

items.name: Bahadir 920
items.description:
A tactical submachine gun with reduced recoil and a high rate of fire. The unusual magazine from the 918 was replaced with a more standard one, less prone to jamming.

If that makes it more "reliable" or more "boring" depends on the individual.

items.name: Bahadir Cylinder Mag
items.description: A unique cylinder magazine for an SMG.

items.name: Bahadir Extended Handguard
items.description: An extended handguard with rails for mounting accessories. Designed for a specific SMG.

items.name: Bahadir Handguard
items.description: A standard handguard for a very non-standard submachine gun.

items.name: Bahadir Homemade Cylinder Mag
items.description: A makeshift, high-capacity magazine with a unique cylinder design.

items.name: Bahadir Railed Handguard
items.description: A handguard for an unusual SMG. Has rails to allow for mounting accessories.

items.name: Bahadir Ribbed Cylinder Mag
items.description: A unique cylinder magazine for an SMG, with a ribbed design.

items.name: Bakelite Pistol Grip Module
items.description: A highly adaptable bakelite pistol grip for rifles, shotguns and SMGs.

items.name: Balistic Kask
items.description: One of the most common pieces of Pre-War soldier equipment, this cheaply mass-produced helmet is sturdy enough against bludgeon attacks, but will not stop a bullet.

items.name: Bandage
items.description:
These tattered bandages look like they’ll infect my wounds rather than protect them.

Still, it’s better than nothing – and I’ve used worse.

items.name: Bandage Blueprint
items.description: This should teach me to craft Bandages.

items.name: Bandit Duds
items.description: A set of clothes from local Bandits. Surprisingly appropriate for running around and shooting people.

items.name: Bandit Orders
items.description: Acolytes careless w/ supplies. You find anything else, take it to the East camp.

items.name: Barrel of Lime
items.description: A barrel full of sacks of agricultural lime, which farmers use to help fertilize the soil. Heavy and cumbersome.

items.name: Basic Gun Repair Kit
items.description: Used by scavengers to fix poorly maintained pre-War weaponry. Useful in a pinch.

items.name: Basic Gun Repair Kit Blueprint
items.description: With his, I can learn to set up a small kit for basic gun repairs.

items.name: Bat Fang
items.description:
The extracted fang of a bat. Were these animals always poisonous, or is that because of the Mist and radiation?

Gives me the creeps.

items.name: Beans Soup
items.description:
A very tasty (and expensive) soup made from beans, berries and meat.

The stew is so thick that I’m more than full by the time I finish eating. Makes me drowsy.

items.name: Berry Puree
items.description:
Mudlarks created this dish that only a few merchants dared taste.

They believe it enhances one’s awareness of the Mist...

items.name: Big Filter
items.description: A large filter for some sort of liquid; most likely an automobile part.

items.name: Binoculars
items.description: A pair of well-made, pre-War binoculars that have resisted the years. The casing is banged up, but the lenses have been preserved.

items.name: Biodiesel Can
items.description: A can of homemade, usable fuel – not expired like the stuff made back before the War. Some very smart folks figured out how to make this from grains, vegetable oil and alcohol, or so I've heard.

items.name: Borealis 12
items.description: A semi-automatic shotgun that fans of the Mikhail series will be very comfortable with. Good for close ranges – breaching rooms, turning corners and blowing up limbs. Just remember to hold it tight.

This is a customized model with some tactical adjustments and improved grip.

items.description: A sturdy folding stock that can be adjusted to the operator's preference.

items.name: Borealis Adaptable Railed Handguard
items.description: A highly adaptable handguard for a semi-automatic shotgun.

items.description: A high-quality polymer handguard designed for a semi-automatic shotgun.

items.name: Borealis Polymer Short Handguard
items.description: A short polymer handguard designed for a semi-automatic shotgun.

items.name: Borealis Pristine Handguard
items.description: A handguard in pristine state, designed for a semi-automatic shotgun.

items.name: Borealis Railed Handguard
items.description: A handguard designed for a semi-automatic shotgun, with a railed mount that enables adding more components.

items.name: Borealis Skeleton Stock
items.description: A skeleton stock that's light, adjustable and also very durable.

items.name: Borealis Wood Handguard
items.description: A wood handguard designed for a semi-automatic shotgun.

items.name: Borealis Worn Handguard
items.description: A well-worn handguard designed for a semi-automatic shotgun.

items.description:
This freakish gun is a home-brew combination of parts from different guns that were lost to history.

Terrible accuracy, powerful shots, and noise that will be heard across the wastes.

Terrible accuracy, powerful shots, and noise that will be heard across the wastes.

items.name: Brass Shell Casing
items.description: A pendant fashioned out of a spent brass shell casing. Not too subtle.

items.name: Bread
items.description:
This bread is hard on the teeth and it tastes like ashy mold.

I power through each slice because I know it gives me energy.

items.name: Broken MK Receiver
items.description: The broken body of an MK series weapon. Should be salvageable.

items.name: Brown Rags
items.description:
Filthy old rags worn by most Commonfolk of Zalesye.

A reminder that, even after the apocalypse, there's no time wasted in finding the lowest common denominator.

items.name: Butcher Knife
items.description: A common butcher's knife, reappropriated for field use out of desperation. The wooden handle is rotting off.

items.name: Butter
items.description: A great condiment which goes with any meal. Hard to make, rare to come by, and it goes bad pretty fast.

items.name: Camera
items.description:
The world used to be so beautiful that it was worth recording and revisiting. 

The thought lingers as I struggle to connect it with this broken camera husk.

items.name: Can Of Tuna
items.description:
This canned tuna meat has a suspiciously distant expiration date.

Good for me. It’s one of the tastier and most energy-filled rations out there.

items.name: Canned Beans
items.description:
These canned beans are the slop that’s kept me alive all these years.

Can’t even smell or taste them anymore, but they get me through the day.

items.name: Canteen
items.description:
The water around here has a taste. The implication isn’t good.

I should drink this in small swigs throughout the day – lessen the risk of radiation poisoning.

items.name: Car Battery
items.description:
A big and heavy battery, probably drained but still worth something.

Can't imagine how it'd be to see all these vehicles moving.

items.name: Carbine Stock Module
items.description: A very adaptable skeleton A-frame stock for rifles and shotguns.

items.name: Cassette Tape
items.description: A tape used to store sounds and music. Been decades since last I heard one. Don't think I'll find a working device to play this on...

items.name: Chemical Container
items.description: A chemical container for hazardous materials. Must have seemed like a big deal before the Mist.

items.name: Chemical Residue
items.description: A container of industrial waste from when Svarog Factories was still operational.

items.name: Chest Patch
items.description:
A bloody chest patch that could have been given out by folks at the Hospital, or could be homemade.

The only protection it offers is to stop a wound that's already bleeding.

items.name: Cigarettes
items.description:
A time-tested drug which at once relaxes and keeps us alert.

Not even the Mist can prevent a Vulture from taking these out in the middle of a scavenge.

items.name: Classic Scope
items.description: A classic model of scope with 4x magnification.

items.name: Common Backpack
items.description: A brown backpack made of leather and nylon, relatively comfortable and durable.

items.name: Commonfolk Rags
items.description: A bundle of rags worn by the common men and women of Zalesye. The low quality cloth makes them even more vulnerable than they already are.

items.name: Core Detector
items.description:
A detector for the Core of different Aspects.

Highly specialized equipment which serves only the bravest and most suicidal of Vultures.

items.name: Corroded Ammo Belt Links
items.description: Old and ravaged ammo belt links. Must've aspired to feed a machine gun before being forgotten in the wastes.

items.name: Crowbar
items.description:
This tool is mostly useful for clearing out debris, helping crafty scavengers search buildings more easily.

They can also be used as a last resort in combat.

items.name: Currant Berries
items.description:
These berries are a common find in every region I’ve traveled.

They grow even in areas full of Mist, but how this affects the fruit, I don’t know.

items.name: Diamond Ring
items.description:
A diamond ring which probably symbolized some sort of love or marriage. 

Priceless before the War; could someone in Zalesye still be interested?

items.name: Document
items.description:
Old documents that miraculously survived the War and the Mist.

They seem very trivial and bureaucratic in nature.

items.name: Dog Ear
items.description: This ear from a mutated hound has a bunch of cartilage which is actually quite useful for medicinal purposes.

items.name: Dog Skin
items.description:
Skin from a Drekavac hound, used for clothes and shelter.

Don't stick around when they're tanning it, shit smell.

items.name: Dog Tag
items.description:
A Palatine's dog tag with the name "Ilich", brought all the way here from the Scrapyard.
Found near his corpse, and just as cold.

items.name: Dragoon 2-Slot Compensator
items.description: A compensator with 2 slots for ventilation, designed for long-range rifles but very adaptable. Reduces muzzle rise.

items.name: Dragoon Dust Cover
items.description: Standard dust cover that fits the Dragoon.

items.name: Dragoon Folding Stock
items.description: A folding stock that helps keep the Dragoon more compact without sacrificing functionality.

items.name: Dragoon Large Steel Mag
items.description: A large stamped steel magazine for a long-range marksman rifle.

items.name: Dragoon Lock Mount Handguard
items.description: An extended handguard with a lock mount for accessories. Made for long-range assault rifles.

items.name: Dragoon Modern Stock
items.description: A modern and durable folding stock based on a classic design.

items.name: Dragoon Polymer Handguard
items.description: A standard polymer handguard for heavy, long-range assault rifles.

items.name: Dragoon Polymer Stock
items.description: A poylmer stock based on a classic design.

items.name: Dragoon Railed Dust Cover
items.description: A dust cover for the Dragoon with a rail for mounting accessories.

items.name: Dragoon Railed Handguard
items.description: An extended handguard with rails for mounting accessories. Made for long-range assault rifles.

items.name: Dragoon Repaired Wood Stock
items.description: A repaired wood stock based on a classic design.

items.name: Dragoon Steel Mag
items.description: A stamped steel magazine for a long-range marksman rifle.

items.name: Dragoon Wood Handguard
items.description: A standard wood handguard for heavy, long-range assault rifles.

items.name: Dragoon Wood Stock
items.description: A standard wood stock based on a classic design.

items.name: Dragoon Wrapped Handguard
items.description: A wrapped handguard for heavy, long-range assault rifles.

items.name: Dried Mushrooms
items.description:
These dried mushrooms are specially prepared to give psychoactive effects.

They’ve been dulled by age, but I should still be careful when I eat this.

items.name: Dried Steak
items.description:
While I think I could find rocks that are juicier than this, the nutrition here is undeniable.

Just gotta make sure I have the time when I take this out to chew it.

items.name: Dried Steak Blueprint
items.description: This should teach me to make Dried Steak.

items.name: Dusty Overcoat
items.description:
A reliable dust coat is an important part of a Scavenger’s attire, since it protects against the unpredictable weather, dust and debris of the areas near the Thresholds.

Although there is not much variety to be found in this category, it’s still very important to keep one’s dust coat relatively clean and in one piece.

items.name: Echelon - Cherry Lime Landmine
items.description:
A tasty drink to get your mind off the horrors all around!
Gives a performance boost too. Now, where to find some more?

items.name: Echelon - Killer Apple
items.description:
A drink so tasty it makes you forget about the surrounding hellscape!
Well... That didn't last long. Time for some more.

items.name: Ekzoskelet Armor
items.description: A Mechanist's bold creation, weaving metal parts in and out of a regular, weathered blouse. They offer great resistance without sacrificing stamina.

items.name: Ekzoskelet Legs
items.description:
A Mechanist's bizarre invention, the Ekzoskelet Legs are a heavy-duty lining of metal parts woven together with regular trousers.

They're designed to offer great resistance and to actually improve the wearer's stamina, but they're still very clumsy to use.

items.name: Electric Wires
items.description: A bundle of electric wires that should be reasonably valuable for a Mechanist.

items.name: Electrical Components
items.description: Bits of cables, wires and other things I don't know about. Lightweight but valuable.

items.name: Elevated Red Dot Sight
items.description: A scope with a red dot sight, elevated for better ergonomics while stalking the wastes.

items.name: Empty Bottle
items.description:
An empty bottle, containing only the despair of alcoholic Commonfolk.

I hear even some pre-War people used to collect tare for money.

items.name: Ergot Fungus Samples
items.description: A spore that grows on cereal and grains. Toxic and hallucinogenic. Needs careful preparation before use for opening my third eye or something like that.

items.name: Expert Gun Repair Kit
items.description: A big case of high-grade tools for critical repairs. Having one of these can be life-saving.

items.name: Expert Gun Repair Kit Blueprint
items.description: This shows me how to make a highly advanced repair kit for weapons, fit only for experts.

items.name: Fabric Scrap
items.description: An old scrap of low-quality fabric, useful for patching up clothes.

items.name: Fang
items.description: Mutants have many teeth. Not that valuable in the market.

items.name: Fang of a Veles
items.description:
A jagged, yellowed fang torn from the mouth of the beast known as Veles. Still slick with the scent of blood and Mist.

Carried as a badge of honor by experienced combatants – or by lunatics who believe it grants them the power of Mist.

items.name: Field Repair Kit
items.description: A spool of threads used to stich together broken armor bits and fabric.

items.name: Field Repair Kit Blueprint
items.description: This shows me how to get together a repair kit that's perfect for those longer outings.

items.name: Fish Soup
items.description:
An eccentric fish soup that’s definitely an acquired taste.

The secret is to cook it for so long that it’s almost not radioactive at all.

items.name: Floppy Disk
items.description:
Information of some sort used to be stored in these, but I don’t know how. 

Lots of things we used to know have been unlearned; what was the point?

items.name: Flux Aspect Core
items.description:
A volatile core extracted from a Flux Aspect. Pulsates with erratic energy.

Mechanists suspect it has many uses, but right now it only serves to electrocute the careless and fetch a high price from the clueless.

items.name: Forbidden Book
items.description:
A dusty book that predates even the War by at least a century.

It speaks of ideologies and History, but uses different languages at the same time. I can't read it.

items.name: Forward Angled Foregrip
items.description: A forward angled foregrip designed to feel comfortable and familiar, like a pistol grip.

items.name: Fresh Cheese
items.description:
A luxury food found throughout Zalesye. Great taste, not much nutrition.

I enjoy cheese more than other people seem to. Makes me almost emotional.

items.name: Fresh Mushrooms
items.description:
Fresh mushrooms with little to no radiation. Tasty, chewy and nutritious – a rare find.

These mushrooms can have drug-like effects when properly dried.

items.name: GP-4 Gas Mask
items.description:
This widespread Gas Mask was issued to Civil Defense and civilians alike, during the times of War. 

Vultures and Bandits often wear these for days at a time, and the mask’s straps dig themselves painfully into the back of their heads.

items.name: Glue
items.description: A small tub of glue used to quickly patch holes in clothing. Useful to have while out in the field.

items.name: Glue Blueprint
items.description: I can learn how to make glue from this.

items.name: Gold Chain
items.description: A gold chain, meant to adorn one's neck. Should be a valuable trade, even if they just melt it down to get the gold.

items.name: Gray Cloth
items.description: A piece of gray cloth; decent fabric, very nondescript.

items.name: Green Cloth
items.description: A piece of cloth that's been dyed green; an unusual color, but it's good-quality cloth.

items.name: Green Rags
items.description:
A bunch of dirty rags, dyed green at a distant point in time; they offer no protection and very little warmth.

These clothes might be valued solely for their extra bit of color. Those who want to stand out for whatever reason may resort to something like this.

items.name: Gun Cleaning Rod
items.description: A ramrod used to clean firearms. Good for scavengers who do long stretches of field work.

items.name: Gun Cleaning Rod Blueprint
items.description: This shows me how to make a ramrod for cleaning guns and such.

items.name: Gun Field Tools
items.description: A set of tools for weapon upkeep in the field. Prevents having to make extensive repairs.

items.name: Gun Field Tools Blueprint
items.description: This can teach me to make a set of tools for repairing and doing upkeep on my guns when I'm out in the field.

items.name: Gun Lube
items.description: A lube used to polish weapons and remove any grime or carbon. Grigory even keeps a personal bottle at his bedside.

items.name: Gun Lube Blueprint
items.description: This shows me how to make some gun lube, to help with weapon repairs.

items.name: Gunner Apparel
items.description: Pieces of Gunner clothing, designed to be resistant, flexible and intimidating.

items.name: Gunpowder
items.description: A bottle of explosive propellant, useful for certain types of weapons. Heard it's an ancient invention.

items.name: Hammer
items.description:
A simple and reliable tool, for all kinds of work I don't do.

Not very handy in combat, as Mutants have sturdy bones. Maybe better against humans?

items.name: Handstop
items.description: A small handstop designed to give some comfort without changing one's preferred hold.

items.name: Head Patch
items.description:
A bloody head patch that could have been given out by folks at the Hospital, or could be homemade.

It barely retains any warmth, offers no protection, and gives off a rotten stink.

items.name: Headache Pills
items.description:
A pre-War drug for headaches and nausea... Stuff with no apparent cause.

Has broader applications nowadays.

items.name: Heavy Armor Repair Kit
items.description: High-grade tools for fixing up heavy armor that's seen a lot of action. Maybe just carrying this around attracts good armor loot?

items.name: Heavy Armor Repair Kit Blueprint
items.description: With this, I can learn to make repair kits for heavily armored gear. I'll be bulletproof.

items.name: Hero of Rhos Medal
items.description: Top-notch soldiers would get these for distinguished service during the War. Seems this motivation wasn't enough to win, though.

items.name: High Caliber Rifle AP Ammo
items.description: Armor piercing variant of high-caliber rifle ammo. A nice tactical advantage.

items.name: High Caliber Rifle FMJ Ammo
items.description: High-caliber, full metal jacket ammo. As reliable as they come.

items.name: High Caliber Rifle HP Ammo
items.description: Hollow point variant of high-caliber rifle ammo. Lots of stopping power – and pain.

items.name: Holographic Sight
items.description: A lightweight and compact scope with a quality holographic sight.

items.name: IFAK Medkit
items.description: A mixture of many medical items found in the wasteland, all in one package.

items.name: IFAK Medkit Blueprint
items.description: With this, I'll figure out how to mix different medical items found in the wastes into a single easy-to-use kit.

items.name: Industrial Capacitor
items.description: A heavy metal cylinder designed to hold and release electrical charges – or so a Mechanist told me.

items.name: Insecticide
items.description:
A nasty spray to keep away the roaches.
Probably works on me too, by this point.

items.name: Jerry Can
items.description: An old fuel canister, meant to transport pre-War fuel. Whatever's still inside this doesn't serve much purpose anymore.

items.name: Kevlar Weave
items.description: A fabric designed for high impact resistance, usually sewn onto armor to make it bulletproof.

items.name: Land Mine
items.description:
The Konzerva is a deadly and difficult to disarm landmine that saw heavy use in the war. 

It has a large blast radius, but leaves one exposed while setting it.

items.name: Large Metal Scrap
items.description:
A few metal scraps, probably useful for somebody.
The clink they make drives me crazy.

items.name: Large Pumpkin
items.description:
A huge lunk of food which tastes and smells sweet. Usually painstakingly grown by more experienced farmers.

Big enough to make about 3 meals, as long as I can carry it around.

items.name: Leg Patch
items.description:
A bloody leg patch that could have been given out by folks at the Hospital, or could be homemade.

There's not much to be gained from wearing this if your wounds are already healed.

items.name: Leon 1895
items.description: A powerful seven-shot revolver with slow reload times, the Leon M1895 is a weapon for the experienced and the confident; difficult to master, but extremely deadly.

items.name: Leon 1895 (Long)
items.description: A powerful seven-shot revolver with slow reload times, the Leon 1895 is a weapon for the experienced and the confident; difficult to master, but extremely deadly.

items.name: Leon 1895 (Long)
items.description: A powerful seven-shot revolver with slow reload times, the Leon M1895 is a weapon for the experienced and the confident; difficult to master, but extremely deadly.

items.name: Leon 1895 (Short)
items.description: A powerful seven-shot revolver with slow reload times, the Leon 1895 is a weapon for the experienced and the confident; difficult to master, but extremely deadly.

items.name: Leon Bakelite Grip
items.description: A standard bakelite grip for revolvers.

items.name: Leon Stock
items.description: A standard stock for the Leon revolver.

items.name: Leon Wood Grip
items.description: A standard wood grip for revolvers.

items.name: Letter to Ayda
items.description:
Ayda my love,
Went to dredge up the trash from the pond - back soon

Sorry about before. I know we'll make it work
This will be our home

items.name: Light Bulb
items.description:
A light bulb that seems to have stood the test of time. 

Might be worth offering to a Mechanist.

items.name: Lightweight 2x Scope
items.description: A glass prism scope with 2x magnification. Lightweight and sturdy with an aluminum construction.

items.name: Lightweight 4x Scope
items.description: A durable and versatile scope with 4x magnification and useable even in low light conditions.

items.name: Lipstick
items.description: The implicit sensuality of this item is entirely lost on me. Might as well trade it.

items.name: Lover's Note
items.description:
He is still alive. We should give up.
God wants us to separate. I'll go East.
Do not follow.
- Alec

items.name: Lyada Toolbox
items.description:
A special toolbox which must have been pretty popular in the factories of wartime.
The box itself must be as valuable as the tools inside.

items.name: M4 Adaptable Extended Handguard
items.description: An extended handguard with a modern slotted mount on top of an old, reliable rail system. Keeps options open when customizing.

items.name: M4 Adaptable Handguard
items.description: A handguard with a modern slotted mount on top of an old, reliable rail system. Keeps options open when customizing.

items.description: A durable aluminum handguard for the M4 family, in tan.

items.name: M4 Aluminum Mag
items.description: A stamped aluminum mag, durable and light.

items.name: M4 Aluminum Mag (Tan)
items.description: A stamped aluminum mag, durable and light, in tan.

items.name: M4 Ergonomic Pistol Grip Module
items.description: An ergonomic pistol grip, highly adaptable for makeshift guns, rifles and SMGs.

items.name: M4 Fixed Stock
items.description: A standard fixed stock for an M4. Reliable, consistent and not a danger to one's beard.

items.name: M4 Gen2 Drum Mag
items.description: An ingenious double-cylinder mag designed to double your fun with the M4.

items.description: A well-made M4 handguard with a tan finish.

items.description: A wrapped and worn aluminum handguard for the M4.

items.description: A common compensator originally for the Mikhail series, helping to reduce muzzle rise and recoil.

items.description: A standard drum-shaped magazine with higher capacity than the flat ones.

items.description: A small steel magazine for the Mikhail.

items.description: A large steel lined polymer magazine for the Mikhail, in umber.

items.description: An assault rifle handguard with a unique, forward-protruding vertical grip for added control.

items.description: A wrapped magazine for the Mikhail.

items.description: A wrapped wood handguard for certain rifles.

items.description: A makeshift stock good for homebrew weapons, with good adjustability options.

items.name: Makeshift Beavertail Pistol Grip
items.description: A pistol grip with a slight curved extension at the top to prevent slide bite.

items.name: Makeshift Collapsible Stock Module
items.description: A makeshift collapsible buttstock based on an M4 design, but adaptable for rifles and shotguns.

items.name: Makeshift Crutch Stock
items.description: An improvised stock with an interesting crutch design.

items.name: Makeshift Cushioned Crutch Stock
items.description: An improvised stock with an interesting cushioned crutch design.

items.description: A makeshift double-stacked stamped steel stick mag.

items.description: A makeshift grated stock good for homebrew weapons.

items.description: A makeshift L shaped stock good for homebrew weapons.

items.description: A makeshift, high-capacity stamped steel stick mag.

items.description: A makeshift padded polymer stock designed for stability without sacrificing ease of handling.

items.name: Makeshift Polymer Padded Stock
items.description: A makeshift polymer stock with a padded design for added comfort and reduced recoil.

items.description: A makeshift stock designed for stability without sacrificing ease of handling.

items.name: Makeshift Prosthetic Stock
items.description: A makeshift prosthetic stock good for homebrew weapons.

items.name: Makeshift Reinforced Triangle Stock
items.description: A makeshift reinforced triangle stock, ergonomic but not very adjustable.

items.name: Makeshift Reinforced Wire Stock
items.description: A makeshift and lightweight reinforced wire stock.

items.name: Makeshift Skeleton Stock w/ Pouch
items.description: A makeshift stock with a side saddle attached for holding extra ammo.

items.name: Makeshift Steel Pistol Grip
items.description: A resilient pistol grip made for all sorts of homebrew guns.

items.name: Makeshift Steel Stick Mag
items.description: A makeshift mag, good for homemade weapons. Made from stamped steel.

items.name: Makeshift Stock w/ Side Saddle
items.description: A makeshift stock with a side saddle attached for holding extra ammo.

items.name: Makeshift Suspension Stock
items.description: A makeshift stock made in the suspension fork style to absorb recoil. Good for homebrew weapons.

items.name: Makeshift Wood Pistol Grip
items.description: A homebrew pistol grip for a homebrew gun. Wood gives a good look.

items.name: Makeshift Worn Stock
items.description: A makeshift stock for homebrew weapons that's dangerously close to disintegrating.

items.name: Makeshift Worn Wood Stock
items.description: A makeshift worn wood stock, good for some homebrew weapons.

items.name: Makeshift Wrapped Pistol Grip
items.description: A makeshift, wrapped, steel pistol grip for all sorts of homebrew guns.

items.name: Meat Drumstick
items.description:
A piece of meat, straight from the bone. Tasty enough, but not ideal for health.

One of the most common ways to eat meat in Zalesye.

items.name: Meat Drumstick Blueprint
items.description: This should teach me to make Meat Drumsticks.

items.name: Meat Skewer
items.description:
The secret of making this delicious skewer is to undercook the meat, keeping it very tender.

This does, however, mean the radiation’s still in there.

items.name: Meat Skewer Blueprint
items.description: This should teach me to make Meat Skewers.

items.name: Mechanical Components
items.description: Small gears, levers and bits of machinery. Not too big or high-quality, but still probably worth something.

items.name: Mechanist Workwear
items.description: Greasy clothes from an industrious Mechanist, in decent condition.

items.name: Medicinal Herb
items.description:
A medicinal herb commonly used in Zalesye.

Some of its supposed uses are sketchy, but tradition makes us toss 'em in the pot anyway.

items.name: Medium Armor Repair Kit
items.description: A kit of sturdy tools used to fix Medium armor. Only experienced scavengers will find a real use for it.

items.name: Medium Armor Repair Kit Blueprint
items.description: This shows how to set up a repair kit for some pretty reliable armor. Great for upkeep in the field.

items.name: Medved Drum Mag
items.description: A homebrew version of a drum mag with great capacity. Maybe not too reliable.

items.name: Medved Grip Blueprint
items.description: This should teach me to craft a Medved Monster Grip.

items.name: Medved Handguard
items.description: A makeshift wood handguard for homebrew weapons.

items.name: Medved Handguard Blueprint
items.description: This should teach me to craft a Medved Monster Handguard.

items.name: Medved Large Makeshift Suppressor
items.description: A large makeshift suppressor originally for the Medved. Not too ineffective, all things considered.

items.name: Medved Magazine Blueprint
items.description: This should teach me to craft a Medved Monster Magazine.

items.name: Medved Makeshift Suppressor
items.description: A small makeshift suppressor originally intended for the Medved. Hopefully it doesn't blow up.

items.name: Medved Monster
items.description:
A repeater creatively assembled out of random parts.

Decent accuracy, but prone to jamming. Not one's first option, but certainly not one's last (unless they die.)

items.name: Metal Breastplate
items.description:
A heavy and effective metal breasplate fitted onto good-quality cloth. Provides good defense at the cost of some mobility.

This much metal on a piece of armor is better worn hidden under a coat of some sort; otherwise, the wearer becomes a shiny, walking target.

items.name: Metal Pipe
items.description: A metal pipe left over from some sort of equipment or construction. Good for trading.

items.name: Metal Scrap
items.description: Scraps of metal that can be recycled into something useful by able hands.

items.name: Metal Scrap
items.description: Assorted metal pieces, scraps, and strips, useful for trading. The bread and butter of any Vulture.

items.name: Microrayon Bunker Key
items.description: A key to a Bunker tucked away in the old housing district. Rada folk were scared to give me access… Guess I’ll find out why soon.

items.name: Mikhai 50 Handguard and Gas Tube Assembly
items.description: A wood handguard for the beastly .50 cal rifle, attached to the gas tube.

items.name: Mikhail 47
items.description: The most commonly found assault rifle in the world, favored by Vultures who treasure reliability and ease of use.

items.name: Mikhail 47
items.description:
The most commonly found assault rifle in the world, favored by Vultures who treasure reliability and ease of use.

This is the quintessential Full Stock model, with good performance all across the board, from close to medium-long ranges.

items.name: Mikhail 47
items.description:
The most commonly found assault rifle in the world, favored by Vultures who treasure reliability and ease of use.

This is the quintessential Full Stock model, with good performance all across the board, from close to medium-long ranges.

items.name: Mikhail 47
items.description: The most commonly found assault rifle in the world, favored by Vultures who treasure reliability and ease of use.

items.name: Mikhail 50
items.description: An incredibly high-caliber weapon capable of exploding its targets from a distance. Hard to maintain and not yet battle-tested, but the pure firepower makes up for any surprises.

items.name: Mikhail 50 (Pristine)
items.description:
An incredibly high-caliber weapon capable of exploding its targets from a distance. Hard to maintain and not yet battle-tested, but the pure firepower makes up for any surprises.

This pristine, scoped version could be used to snipe a chopper out of the sky. Maybe that's what it was built for in the War.

items.name: Mikhail 50 (Prototype)
items.description:
An incredibly high-caliber weapon capable of exploding its targets from a distance. Hard to maintain and not yet battle-tested, but the pure firepower makes up for any surprises.

This is a prototype version, not as sturdy as its offspring.

items.name: Mikhail 50 Drum Mag
items.description: If I want more fun out of my beastly .50 cal, this is the way to do it.

items.name: Mikhail 50 Handguard
items.description: A standard handguard for the beastly .50 cal rifle.

items.name: Mikhail 50 Large Mag
items.description: A large, reliable mag for the Mikhail 50.

items.name: Mikhail 50 Mag
items.description: A standard size mag for the Mikhail 50.

items.name: Mikhail 50 Polymer Handguard
items.description: A polymer handguard for the beastly .50 cal rifle.

items.name: Mikhail 50 Thin-Vent Compensator
items.description: A cheap compensator with thin vents. Reduces muzzle rise, but not by much, especially in a .50 cal.

items.name: Mikhail 50 Ultra Suppressor
items.description: A highly effective suppressor for the Mikhail 50, with good recoil reduction.

items.name: Mikhail 50 Wide-Vent Compensator
items.description: A compensator with wide vents that helps control the muzzle rise of a monstrous .50 cal.

items.name: Mikhail 50 Wood Handguard
items.description: A wood handguard for the beastly .50 cal rifle.

items.name: Mikhail 74 U
items.description: This assault rifle proved extremely dangerous at close- and medium-range skirmishes during the pre-Mist wars. However, being a newer weapon, ammunition and parts are scarce.

items.name: Mikhail 74 U
items.description:
This assault rifle proved extremely dangerous at close- and medium-range skirmishes during the pre-Mist wars. However, being a newer weapon, ammunition and parts are scarce.

This model is in pristine condition, improving handling and accuracy.

items.name: Mist Powercell
items.description: An experimental container of Mist that doesn't seem very effective. Figuring out a use for Mist would be big news...

items.name: Moldy Cheese
items.description:
A piece of cheese that’s been left uneaten for too long. Smells foul, but one can acquire a taste for it.

On the edge of “experimental” and “poisonous” – but I am experienced enough to appreciate it.

items.name: Molotov Cocktail
items.description:
This item can be thrown at short and medium ranges, and explodes into a ball of fire upon hitting a hard surface.

They can be used to kill or to limit the movement options of enemies.

items.name: Moonshine
items.description:
Locally brewed alcohol in a repurposed bottle that used to store real vodka.

Most of the drunks around here will take what they can get.

items.name: Moonshine Blueprint
items.description: This right here'll teach me how to make moonshine. Hope I don't mess this up, or I could go blind.

items.name: Morphine
items.description:
A pre-War drug, expertly made by medical scientists for numbing pain. A rare find.

Acolytes would love to get their hands on this, but I've heard it's addictive.

items.name: Morphine Blueprint
items.description: This blueprint teaches how to make morphine, which can help deal with all the pains that Zalesye has to offer.

items.name: Mudlark Tatters
items.description: Shoddy garments from a corpse-bearer, carrying the scent of death through Zalesye.

items.name: Mutant Steak
items.description: Only the desperate would eat this piece of irradiated meat before properly cooking or processing it.

items.name: Mutated Stick
items.description:
A warped and splintered stick harvested from mutated vegetation. Too brittle for tools or weapons, but strange properties remain in its fibers.

It twitches slightly when held — whatever grew this, it’s still half-alive.

items.name: Mystery Pills
items.description:
A prewar drug with half of a complicated name written in the back.

Whatever it is makes the pain go away.

items.name: Note From Alexei
items.description:
Rodion – I had to leave for the Cemetery up north. Please drop by.

Grigory might have a cheap weapon for you to buy so you can make your way here. He's southwest of the Hospital, as usual.
- Alexei

items.name: Note From Anatoly
items.description:
To the scavenger: I have gone to study the anomalous energy flux right down the road. Bring the toolbox there.
- Anatoly

items.name: Old Blue Trousers
items.description:
A pair of old trousers adorned with crusty stains and accompanied by a strong smell.

The material is reasonably resistant and won't break apart too easily.

items.name: Old Canteen
items.description: An old and rusty canteen. Contains a bit of dirty water inside. Probably radioactive...

items.name: Old GP-4 Gas Mask
items.description:
This widespread Gas Mask was issued to Civil Defense and civilians alike, during the times of War. 

Vultures and Bandits often wear these for days at a time, and the mask’s straps dig themselves painfully into the back of their heads.

This one is on the brink of shattering completely, rendering it mostly ineffective.

items.name: Old Kepka
items.description:
An old relic of pre-War times, when caps like this were fashionable among students and workers alike.

This one is very beat-up and on the cusp of dissolving into thin air, but still offers some warmth.

items.name: Old Letter
items.description: An old, crumpled letter, sealed by grime and probably not relevant to life in the wastes.

items.name: Old Tactical Pants
items.description: A pair of beat-up tactical pants worn by the armed men of pre-War times. Offers great mobility and is pretty comfortable, but doesn't protect against the rocky terrain of the wastes.

items.name: Old Tactical Vest
items.description:
A beat-up tactical vest worn by police forces of pre-Mist times. It offers great mobility and decent protection against weaker types of weapon fire.

This vest is usually a reward for those with basic training and experience in the field.

items.name: Overripe Potato
items.description:
A potato with a growth already sprouting out. Not much benefit, but better than nothing.

Could still be cooked, but probably not traded.

items.name: PM 12-70
items.description: A multi-shot pump-action shotgun designed for security and for use by amateurs – if the target's close, it won't matter much who's pulling the trigger.

items.name: PM 12-70 (Extended)
items.description: A multi-shot pump-action shotgun designed for security and for use by amateurs – if the target's close, it won't matter much who's pulling the trigger.

items.name: PM 12-70 (Long / Ext)
items.description: A multi-shot pump-action shotgun designed for security and for use by amateurs – if the target's close, it won't matter much who's pulling the trigger.

items.name: PM 12-70 (Short)
items.description: A multi-shot pump-action shotgun designed for security and for use by amateurs – if the target's close, it won't matter much who's pulling the trigger.

items.name: PM 12-70 (Short)
items.description: A multi-shot pump-action shotgun designed for security and for use by amateurs – if the target's close, it won't matter much who's pulling the trigger.

items.name: PM Bakelite Grip
items.description: A bakelite grip for pistols, with a texture that improves handling.

items.name: PM Drum Mag
items.description: A high-capacity drum mag for pistols. Cumbersome, but gives an advantage in combat.

items.name: PM Ergonomic Pistol Grip
items.description: A shotgun ergonomic pistol grip with a tube adapter for installing other stocks.

items.name: PM Extended Mag
items.description: An extended PM pistol magazine.

items.name: PM Flashlight Forestock
items.description: A shotgun forestock made of polymer, with an integrated flashlight.

items.name: PM Full Polymer Stock
items.description: A full polymer stock for a pump-action shotgun.

items.name: PM Full Stock
items.description: A standard full stock for a pump-action shotgun.

items.name: PM Ivory Grip
items.description: A high-quality ivory grip for pistols. Sometimes it's about looking good.

items.name: PM Muzzle Brake
items.description: A muzzle brake and compensator for the PM Nikolay and other pistols.

items.name: PM Nikolay
items.description: One of the most common weapons throughout Zalesye, this semi-automatic pistol is a great all-rounder against weaker enemies, with decent accuracy and rate-of-fire.
