items.name: PM Nikolay PB
items.description: One of the most common weapons throughout Zalesye, this semi-automatic pistol is a great all-rounder against weaker enemies, with decent accuracy and rate-of-fire.

items.name: PM Pistol Grip
items.description: A shotgun pistol grip with a tube adapter for installing other stocks.

items.name: PM Polymer Beavertail Grip
items.description: A mag made of polymer that improves gun control, with a beavertail curve at the top to protect the hands.

items.name: PM Polymer Stock
items.description: A sawed-off polymer stock for a pump-action shotgun.

items.name: PM Railed Forestock
items.description: A shotgun forestock made of polymer, with a rail for mounting accessories.

items.name: PM Sawn Off Stock
items.description: A sawn-off stock for a pump-action shotgun.

items.name: PM Silencer
items.description: A simple silencer originally designed for the PM Nikolay. Does its job.

items.name: PM Small Compensator
items.description: A small compensator for semi-automatic pistols.

items.name: PM Standard Mag
items.description: A standard PM pistol magazine.

items.name: PM Wrapped Grip
items.description: A bakelite grip for pistols, wrapped with bandages for added thickness and texture.

items.name: PP Polymer Mag
items.description: A worn polymer magazine for an SMG.

items.name: PP Pristine Mag
items.description: A polymer magazine in pristine condition for an SMG.

items.name: PP Wrapped Polymer Mag
items.description: A wrapped polymer magazine for an SMG.

items.name: Palatine Uniform
items.description: Bits of a standard-issue Palatine uniform, modeled after the War heroes of old.

items.name: Panskiy Kask
items.description:
An old aviator's helmet, with stellar wind protection and decent resistance against impact.

However, it's a bit uncomfortable to wear all day long, and it dulls the senses a bit - not ideal for the field.

items.name: Parade Helmet
items.description: A high-quality steel helmet, mass-produced during the War. A red star was painted on it at some point; anyone who would've known what it means is long gone.

items.name: Patched Armored Blouse
items.description:
A decayed padding meant to be fastened and worn on top of one’s shirt, consisting of bits and pieces of ceramic and ballistic nylon, strung together haphazardly. 

This abomination of a vest could only take a couple shots before becoming completely useless.

items.name: Patched Pants
items.description:
Old, raggedy pants, held together by haphazard patches. They offer some warmth where there aren't any holes.

Even sitting in the rubble of Zalesye will hurt your legs when all you have is this.

items.name: Pills
items.description: Largely distributed within Rhos in the beginning of the end, this can treat small doses of radiation poisoning and even heal some wounds

items.name: Pistol AP Ammo
items.description: Armor piercing ammo. They may have gear, but that doesn't mean they're safe.

items.name: Pistol FMJ Ammo
items.description: Ammunition made for pistols, submachine guns, repeaters etc.

items.name: Pistol HP Ammo
items.description: Hollow point ammunition, perfect for self-defense.

items.name: Plastic Scrap
items.description: A scrap of plastic that can maybe be recycled.

items.name: Plated Overcoat
items.description: A quality overcoat with some extra armor plating on the shoulder. The preferred gear for most scavengers, as it's very resistant to weather and the mud and grime of Zalesye.

items.name: Plated Ragged Pants
items.description: A pair of blue pants with defensive platings, tactical pouches and worn out cuffs. A bit difficult to move around in, but sturdy enough.

items.name: Plier
items.description: I’m not the type to pull someone’s teeth out. But what else is this thing for?

items.name: Polymer Pistol Grip Module
items.description: A highly adaptable polymer pistol grip for rifles, shotguns and SMGs.

items.name: Porcelain Figurine
items.description: A delicate recreation of some old political leader. Must've been important to get his face plastered all over the place.

items.name: Power Relay
items.description: An important electrical component that only Mechanists would be able to properly explain.

items.name: Pre-Mist Gold Wristwatch
items.description: A glistening memento from the world before it ended. This country must've been full of rich folks.

items.name: Pre-Mist Money Stack
items.description: A stack of paper bills that were used as money before the War broke out. Wish it had the same value today.

items.name: Precision Sensor Module
items.description: A bit of a machine that must've been used to measure something. Maybe weight or temperature?

items.name: RGD-5 Hand Grenade
items.description: Fragmentation grenades like this are extremely useful for initiating conflicts with a strategic edge, and for moments of retreating.

items.name: Rabbit Ear
items.description:
This rabbit ear would have been fluffy and cute before the Mist's mutations took over.

Now it is just a dry hunk of flesh, useful only for its cartilage.

items.name: Rabbit Eye
items.description: A plucked out eye from a relatively harmless creature. It's not cruelty – rabbits are a hassle to hunt down and they must be stripped for all parts.

items.name: Rabbit Meat
items.description: Gamey meat with not much succulence. Still, less irradiated and repugnant than other mutant meats.

items.name: Rabbit Paw
items.description: Rabbit's paws are considered a lucky item by superstitious folk, and a supremely unlucky item by another type of superstitious folk. Carry at own risk.

items.name: Rada Outfit
items.description: Clothes from a working Rada member, stained with sweat from hard work at the farms.

items.name: Radish
items.description:
A spicy and crispy vegetable which survives the Mist reasonably well.

It’s very hard to find produce in Zalesye, but when I do, it’s usually this.

items.name: Rain Coat
items.description: An old, discarded rain coat that can offer plenty of protection from the constant rains of Zalesye, at the cost of providing very little warmth.

items.name: Rat Fur
items.description: A bunch of fur from a mutant rat. Can be used for cushions, clothes and, if you're a bit daring, in medicine.

items.name: Rat Meat
items.description: Skewered meat from a Mora rat or two; a meager meal if ever there was one, and filthy to boot.

items.name: Rat Placenta
items.description: A blob of placenta from a newborn Mora rat. The more scientifically inclined traders might want to study it.

items.name: Rat Placenta Vial
items.description:
A full vial of Mora rat placenta, collected while holding one's breath.

Must be valuable for Mechanists and such. Is it... Bubbling?

items.name: Rat Tail
items.description: A tail. Few traders might be interested in this.

items.name: Rat Tooth
items.description: A small but pointy tooth from one of the many plagues of Zalesye. Its shape doesn't give away the mutated nature of its owners.

items.name: Rebar
items.description: A reinforcement bar that's very useful for building, as it resists tension. Should be a good trade for anyone who wants a new shack.

items.name: Red Cloth
items.description: A piece of red cloth; good quality, decent smell.

items.name: Red Dot Sight
items.description: A lightweight and durable red dot sight. Simple but reliable.

items.name: Refurbished Kask
items.description: A refurbished helmet from the War, unbalanced and clunky but with decent protection against impact and, with luck, capable of resisting a couple of bullets.

items.name: Reinforced Leather Pants
items.description:
A creased pair of leather pants with bits of scrap metal sewn into the knees.
Useful for the ever-kneeling scavengers as they search for more comfortable armor.

items.name: Repurposed Drill Piece
items.description: Makeshift part from an old power tool, now part of a very dubious weapon.

items.name: Repurposed Drill Piece w/ Handle
items.description: Makeshift part from an old power tool, repurposed as the handle of a shady gun.

items.name: Revolutionary Kepka
items.description:
An old relic of pre-War times, when caps like this were fashionable among students and workers alike.

The pristine condition of this cap is a testament to the strength of ideals that are lost on you.

items.name: Rifle AP Ammo
items.description: Armor piercing ammunition. Good for mowing down some well-equipped enemies.

items.name: Rifle Collapsible Stock Module
items.description: A collapsible buttstock based on an M4 design, but adaptable for rifles and shotguns.

items.name: Rifle FMJ Ammo
items.description: Standard ammunition for rifles.

items.name: Rifle HP Ammo
items.description: Hollow point ammunition for rifles. Don't need great aim when you got this.

items.name: Rifle New Gen Stock Module
items.description: A very reliable and adaptable polymer buttstock for rifles and shotguns.

items.name: Riot Vest
items.description: This extra-sturdy, plated armor seems good enough to hold back a crowd of people, and even withstand some fire. It is heavy and difficult to wear, but survival is worth a little struggle.

items.name: Rope
items.description:
Different factions use rope for different reasons – fastening food containers, keeping shacks upright, erecting totems made of corpses. 

Been getting harder to find.

items.name: Rotheart
items.description: A pulsing organ saturated with mutations and unnatural decay, harvested from a King Tormentil. Valuable to the right people.

items.name: Rubber Scrap
items.description: A scrap of rubber which resisted the years. A very resilient material, and good for trading.

items.name: Ruined Beret
items.description:
Once a classy beret worn by the upper ranks of the pre-War military, now a repulsive piece of headwear that is barely holding together.

A good fit for Zalesye.

items.name: Russet Potato
items.description:
A common food throughout the Continent. Bland, but nutritious.

Hard to eat uncooked. Better off trading these, or having someone prepare them.

items.name: SMG Dust Cover
items.description: Standard dust cover for submachine guns.

items.name: SMG Railed Dust Cover
items.description: A dust cover for submachine guns with a rail for mounting accessories.

items.name: Salt
items.description: Salt: the lifeblood of any meal. Chefs who don't use it in their cooking will all be lynched by angry mobs eventually.

items.name: Sardines
items.description:
The best military ration there is – even if it’s a bit too fermented.

The salty taste makes me thirsty.

items.name: Scavenger Armor Repair Kit
items.description: A kit of repair tools used to fix light armor that's seen its fair share of wear and tear. Practical and scrappy like the scavs that use it.

items.name: Scavenger Armor Repair Kit Blueprint
items.description: This is for learning how to put together a basic, but reliable armor repair kit.

items.name: Scrap Gun Repair Kit
items.description: A set of tools used to repair damaged scrap weapons; only for Rhos' poorest scavengers.

items.name: Scrap Gun Repair Kit Blueprint
items.description: This is for learning how to put together a repair kit for certain types of weapons. Good for survival.

items.name: Scrapyard Armor
items.description:
A large piece of armor plating strapped onto good-quality clothes, offering a mix of warmth and protection.

A reasonable balance between defense and mobility for those with a low budget.

items.name: Scrapyard Pants
items.description: A pair of old pants that's been fitted with armor platings and readjusted to prevent it from falling apart. Offers decent protection.

items.name: Screwdriver
items.description:
A handy tool and it looks well-made.

Could stab something with it in a pinch...
Should probably just sell it.

items.name: Screws
items.description: A bunch of metal screws, hard to find and pick up but valuable for the tinkering types.

items.name: Security Helmet
items.description: A reinforced metal helmet with an armored visor, designed for heavy-duty security work. Offers great protection, but is exhaustive to wear for long periods.

items.name: Settler's Warning
items.description:
to all u fuking soldier boys n girls out there
were comin for ya we re tuffer than gunners
well fuck ur skulls out so dont fuk with us

items.name: Sewing Kit
items.description: A set of pins, needles etc. inside a tin can. Good for maintaining armor while in the field.

items.name: Sewing Kit Blueprint
items.description: With this, I can learn how to make my own sewing kit for small repairs in clothing and armor.

items.name: Short Tapered Vertical Foregrip
items.description: A short polymer vertical foregrip with a slight taper for comfort.

items.name: Short Vertical Foregrip
items.description: A short vertical foregrip designed for ease of use.

items.name: Shotgun Buckshot Ammo
items.description: Buckshot ammunition for shotguns. Good when you want to hit everything in a general direction.

items.name: Shotgun Hollow Point Slugs
items.description: Hollow point slugs for shotguns. Great for hunting mutants. If you accidentally shoot an armored Gunner with this, just apologize and start running.

items.name: Shotgun Sabot Hard-Cast Slugs
items.description: Hard-cast sabot slugs that punch through armor. They might as well be wearing rubakhas.

items.name: Sidemounted 4x Scope
items.description: A high-grade scope with a dovetail side mount and 4x magnification.

items.name: Skull Mask
items.description: A menacing mask in the shape of a skull, worn by different folks for different reasons: some in respect and awe of the dead, others in order to intimidate and scare.

items.name: Small Filter
items.description: A small filter, probably from an old machine or automobile.

items.name: Snake Egg
items.description:
A slimy egg from a mutant snake, which can be cooked or eaten raw in moments of desperation.

I cannot attest to how nutritious this thing could be.

items.name: Sniper 4x Scope
items.description: A high-grade scope originally made for the Dragoon. Has 4x magnification.

items.name: Special FMJ Ammo
items.description: Special ammunition that can fit into different types of weapons.

items.name: Splint
items.description: A medical splint, used to help the injured get around without moving their healing bones.

items.name: Spoiled Radish
items.description:
A slightly nutritious piece of spoiled produce. Makes me sick; should eat in desperate situations only.

Radish survives so well in the Mist that folks who don’t know how to grow them still try it. The result is a bunch of waste.

items.name: Square Battery
items.description: Dried-up batteries – often leaky, sometimes toxic. They come in a variety of formats, from Button Cells to big C-Types.

items.name: Stash Expansion
items.description: Unlocks one additional stash tab when purchased. Each tab has the same storage capacity. Applied immediately, does not take backpack space.

items.name: Stimpack
items.description: A complex mixture of drugs which can be quickly injected and discarded to numb pain, increase adrenaline and get me out of desperate situations.

items.name: Stimpack Blueprint
items.description: This shows how to concoct a mixture from medicinal ingredients, which can then be quickly injected.

items.name: Stronghold Vest
items.description:
A souped-up tactical vest, with shoulder guards and bits of metal woven in throughout the fabric. Offers good protection from weaker weapons, at the cost of mobility.

This combat-oriented vest is usually worn by those have proven themselves capable.

items.name: Structural Alloy Bracket
items.description: A very strong bit of material designed to hold heavy corners in machines, vehicles, bridges and all that.

items.name: Sucker Tongue
items.description:
Tongue from a dangerous Goyan creature, or "Sucker". Its long shape and sliminess make it feel like it's still alive...

Don't wanna be near this thing, much less carry it around.

items.name: Svarsh Anti-Slip Handguard
items.description: A handguard with steel anti-slip grates for a makeshift gun.

items.name: Svarsh Drum Mag
items.description: A drum magazine for extended 12-Gauge round capacity.

items.name: Svarsh Large Steel Mag
items.description: A durable, large stamped steel mag, good for makeshift guns.

items.name: Svarsh Miracle (Long)
items.description:
A mess of a shotgun, taped together from scraps, but still extremely deadly.

Its accuracy leaves a lot to be desired, but the shots are very powerful.

items.name: Svarsh Miracle (Short)
items.description:
A mess of a shotgun, taped together from scraps, but still extremely deadly.

Its accuracy leaves a lot to be desired, but the shots are very powerful.

items.name: Svarsh Miracle (Short)
items.description:
A mess of a shotgun, taped together from scraps, but still extremely deadly.

Its accuracy leaves a lot to be desired, but the shots are very powerful.

items.name: Svarsh Steel Handguard
items.description: A handguard made of grated steel scraps for a makeshift gun.

items.name: Svarsh Steel Mag
items.description: A durable stamped steel mag, good for makeshift guns.

items.name: Svarsh Steel Scraps Handguard
items.description: A handguard made from a combination of polymer and steel scraps, ideal for a makeshift gun.

items.name: Svarsh Stock
items.description: A simple makeshift stock for a homebrew gun.

items.name: Svarsh Wood Handguard
items.description: A wood handguard for a makeshift gun, very finely carved.

items.name: Svarsh Wood Pistol Grip
items.description: A simple, makeshift wood pistol grip.

items.name: Svobodnik M4
items.description: A knock-off of the Mikhail 47 series, the Svobodnik offers great accuracy at the cost of being unwieldy and having a slower rate of fire.

items.name: Svobodnik M4 (Long)
items.description: A knock-off of the Mikhail 47 series, the Svobodnik offers great accuracy at the cost of being unwieldy and having a slower rate of fire.

items.name: T Plug
items.description:
A small piece of plastic used to fit plugs into other plugs... Or something?

Looks pretty worthless.

items.name: TC Dust Cover
items.description: A standard dust cover for a marksman rifle.

items.name: TC Handguard
items.description: A weathered handguard for a marksman rifle.

items.name: TC Polymer Large Mag (Black)
items.description: A large polymer mag for a marksman rifle, in black.

items.name: TC Polymer Large Mag (Black)
items.description: A large polymer mag for a marksman rifle, in black.

items.name: TC Polymer Large Mag (Plum)
items.description: A large polymer mag for a marksman rifle, plum-colored.

items.name: TC Polymer Mag (Black)
items.description: A standard polymer mag for a marksman rifle, in black.

items.name: TC Polymer Mag (Plum)
items.description: A standard polymer mag for a marksman rifle, plum-colored.

items.name: TC Pristine Handguard (Plum)
items.description: A plum-colored handguard for subsonic marksman rifles, in pristine condition.

items.name: TC Railed Dust Cover
items.description: A standard dust cover for marksman rifles, with a rail for mounting accessories.

items.name: TC Railed Handguard
items.description: A weathered handguard for a subsonic marksman rifle, with rails for mounting accessories.

items.name: TC Repaired Compound Stock

items.name: TC Skeleton Stock
items.description: A lightweight skeleton stock for a marksman rifle, with a close-quarters-centric design.

items.name: TC Suppressor Handguard
items.description: A repaired handguard for a subsonic marksman rifle, with a suppressor tucked in.

items.name: TC Taped Stock
items.description: A taped wood stock with a cheek pad. Made for a marksman rifle, with a long-range-centric design.

items.name: TC Wood Stock
items.description: A simple wood stock for a marksman rifle, with a long-range-centric design.

items.name: TC Wrapped Skeleton Stock
items.description: A lightweight, wrapped skeleton stock for a marksman rifle, with a close-quarters-centric design.

items.name: Tactical Knife
items.description: A small and convenient weapon for last-resort situations. Desperate Scavengers use them to fend off incoming threats for as long as they can, typically while trying to fall back.

items.name: Tapered Vertical Foregrip
items.description: A standard polymer vertical foregrip with a slight taper for comfort.

items.name: Task Dog Tag
items.description: Task_Dog_Tag_2x1

items.name: Tattered Armor Repair Kit
items.description: A repair kit for clothes that have seen better days. Used to fix up scrap armor by some of the poorest scavengers in Rhos.

items.name: Tattered Armor Repair Kit Blueprint
items.description: This blueprint can teach me how to put together some tools for repairing some very tattered clothes. Better than nothing...

items.name: Thermometer
items.description:
A miraculously functioning thermometer.
I've heard the silver liquid inside is a metal.

items.name: Thread Cutter
items.description: This suppressed marksman rifle excels at long ranges. While not as powerful as a Dragoon, it's reasonably silent and easy to use.

items.description: A homemade forestock with a handstop for ease of operation.

items.name: Tinker Handguard
items.description: A compact handguard good for a makeshift assault rifle, and adaptable for other guns.

items.name: Tinker Integrated Pistol Grip Stock
items.description: A makeshift integrated pistol grip and stock.

items.name: Tinker Leather Wrapped Forestock
items.description: A repurposed polymer forestock for a makeshift weapon.

items.name: Tinker Lengthy Pistol Grip
items.description: A homemade extra length pistol grip. Good for makeshift guns.

items.name: Tinker Pistol Grip
items.description: A homemade wooden pistol grip. Good for makeshift guns.

items.name: Tinker Polymer Forestock
items.description: A homemade forestock made with a durable polymer.

items.name: Tinker Quality Wood Forestock
items.description: A handcrafted forestock made of quality wood.

items.name: Tinker Side-Saddle Forestock
items.description: A repurposed polymer forestock with an ammo holder. Made for a makeshift weapon.

items.name: Tinker Sport Pistol Grip
items.description: A homemade pistol grip designed for competitive shooting. Good for makeshift guns.

items.name: Tinker Vert Grip Forestock
items.description: A homebrew version of a forestock with a vertical grip for added ergonomy.

items.name: Tinker Wood Scrap Forestock
items.description: A handcrafted forestock made of repurposed wood scraps.

items.name: Toilet Paper
items.description: If I could find one of these that didn't feel like a sand file, I’d be the richest man in Zalesye.

items.name: Trophy
items.description:
A trophy from some sort of competitive event of old. An athletic male figure is depicted posing as the victor.

Can't tell what the competition was supposed to be, though.

items.name: Undead Arm
items.description: A human arm, still twitching from whatever monstrous properties the Mist has given to its unlucky previous owner.

items.name: Vegetable Soup
items.description:
A surprisingly good soup made from many vegetables, slowly cooked.

One of the heartier meals one can get in Zalesye without risk of radiation sickness.

items.name: Veles Hide
items.description:
The thick, scarred hide of Veles, bearing the marks of countless battles.

Its dense fur and resilient skin offer exceptional protection against the elements and hostile creatures. Ideal for crafting durable armor or insulating shelter.

items.name: Veles Paw
items.description:
A massive, severed paw from Veles, the apex predator of the wasteland. 

The claws are thick as knives, and the pads are calloused from years of stalking prey. Hunters prize it as a trophy.

items.name: Veles T-Bone Steak
items.description:
A hefty cut of meat from Veles' hindquarters. Rich in protein and marbled with fat, it's a rare delicacy in the wasteland.

Consuming it restores significant energy, but the lingering taste of the wild might not be for everyone.

items.name: Vertical Foregrip
items.description: A standard vertical foregrip designed for ease of use.

items.name: Vintage Red Dot Sight
items.description: A light and sturdy red dot sight with a vintage design.

items.name: Vozhd Beret
items.description:
A classy beret meant to be casually worn by the upper ranks of the pre-War military.

Its dignity and style is unlikely to be conveyed in the muddy pits of the Mire.

items.name: Vulture Wear
items.description: Clothes from a Vulture. You have to scrap the mud off to feel the cloth.

items.name: WG-40
items.description:
A lubricant bottle so old and busted I'd need lubricant to open it.

Still valuable for the tinkerers in Zalesye.

items.name: Water Filter
items.description:
A very reliable filter for the murky water we get 'round here.

Valuable and shiny. Shouldn't leave it in the open.

items.name: Whole Roasted Fish
items.description:
The sharp crackle of fish bones against my teeth keeps me on edge, but does nothing for nutrition.

This thing came from the dirty waters of Lake Pavlie. I should eat these sparingly.

items.name: Winter Pants
items.description: A pair of thick, ragged pants with numerous patches; made by survivalists who don't mind a little extra sweat.

items.name: Wooden Pistol Grip Module
items.description: A highly adaptable wooden pistol grip for rifles, shotguns and SMGs.

items.name: Worm Meat
items.description: Gooey and surprisingly elastic worm meat. Have to chew for hours and hours. So much fun.

items.name: Worm Skin
items.description: A strangely elastic and resilient piece of skin, which could be useful for making clothes.

items.name: Yellow Cloth
items.description: A piece of yellow cloth; a very light and raggedy fabric.

items.name: Zavod 34
items.description:
A reliable double-barreled shotgun, mostly used for hunting.

Devastating at short-range but virtually useless at a distance, this weapon is for the Scavenger who’s not afraid of taking risks.

items.description: A full stock for an over-under shotgun.

items.description: A full polymer stock for an over-under shotgun.

items.name: Zavod Polymer Handguard
items.description: A polymer handguard for easier handling of an over-under shotgun.

items.name: Zavod Wood Handguard
items.description: A simple wood handguard for an over-under shotgun.

items.name: Zavod Wood Stock
items.description: A sawn off wood stock for over-under shotguns.

items.name: Zavod Wrapped Wood Handguard
items.description: A wrapped wood handguard for an over-under shotgun.

equipment.name: Acolyte Robes
equipment.description: Bits of robes and undergarments from the dedicated Acolytes, just as modest as the lives they lead.

equipment.name: Armored Rags
equipment.description:
A sorry bunch of rags with some improvised armored plating strapped to them. Better than nothing, but not enough to stop a bullet.

Many scavengers and highwaymen start off their careers with this sort of scrapped-together attire.

equipment.name: Ashen Ushanka
equipment.description:
A very common piece of headwear throughout Zalesye, and one of the first trades people make when they come into some money.

Its comfy shape and texture are great against the cold, but don't offer much protection.

equipment.name: Balistic Kask
equipment.description: One of the most common pieces of Pre-War soldier equipment, this cheaply mass-produced helmet is sturdy enough against bludgeon attacks, but will not stop a bullet.

equipment.name: Bandit Duds
equipment.description: A set of clothes from local Bandits. Surprisingly appropriate for running around and shooting people.

equipment.name: Binoculars
equipment.description: A pair of well-made, pre-War binoculars that have resisted the years. The casing is banged up, but the lenses have been preserved.

equipment.name: Brown Rags
equipment.description:
Filthy old rags worn by most Commonfolk of Zalesye.

A reminder that, even after the apocalypse, there's no time wasted in finding the lowest common denominator.

equipment.name: Chest Patch
equipment.description:
A bloody chest patch that could have been given out by folks at the Hospital, or could be homemade.

The only protection it offers is to stop a wound that's already bleeding.

equipment.name: Common Backpack
equipment.description: A brown backpack made of leather and nylon, relatively comfortable and durable.

equipment.name: Commonfolk Rags
equipment.description: A bundle of rags worn by the common men and women of Zalesye. The low quality cloth makes them even more vulnerable than they already are.

equipment.name: Dusty Overcoat
equipment.description:
A reliable dust coat is an important part of a Scavenger’s attire, since it protects against the unpredictable weather, dust and debris of the areas near the Thresholds.

Although there is not much variety to be found in this category, it’s still very important to keep one’s dust coat relatively clean and in one piece.

equipment.name: Ekzoskelet Armor
equipment.description: A Mechanist's bold creation, weaving metal parts in and out of a regular, weathered blouse. They offer great resistance without sacrificing stamina.

equipment.name: Ekzoskelet Legs
equipment.description:
A Mechanist's bizarre invention, the Ekzoskelet Legs are a heavy-duty lining of metal parts woven together with regular trousers.

They're designed to offer great resistance and to actually improve the wearer's stamina, but they're still very clumsy to use.

equipment.name: GP-4 Gas Mask
equipment.description:
This widespread Gas Mask was issued to Civil Defense and civilians alike, during the times of War. 

Vultures and Bandits often wear these for days at a time, and the mask’s straps dig themselves painfully into the back of their heads.

equipment.name: Green Rags
equipment.description:
A bunch of dirty rags, dyed green at a distant point in time; they offer no protection and very little warmth.

These clothes might be valued solely for their extra bit of color. Those who want to stand out for whatever reason may resort to something like this.

equipment.name: Gunner Apparel
equipment.description: Pieces of Gunner clothing, designed to be resistant, flexible and intimidating.

equipment.name: Head Patch
equipment.description:
A bloody head patch that could have been given out by folks at the Hospital, or could be homemade.

It barely retains any warmth, offers no protection, and gives off a rotten stink.

equipment.name: Leg Patch
equipment.description:
A bloody leg patch that could have been given out by folks at the Hospital, or could be homemade.

There's not much to be gained from wearing this if your wounds are already healed.

equipment.name: Mechanist Workwear
equipment.description: Greasy clothes from an industrious Mechanist, in decent condition.

equipment.name: Metal Breastplate
equipment.description:
A heavy and effective metal breasplate fitted onto good-quality cloth. Provides good defense at the cost of some mobility.

This much metal on a piece of armor is better worn hidden under a coat of some sort; otherwise, the wearer becomes a shiny, walking target.

equipment.name: Mudlark Tatters
equipment.description: Shoddy garments from a corpse-bearer, carrying the scent of death through Zalesye.

equipment.name: Old Blue Trousers
equipment.description:
A pair of old trousers adorned with crusty stains and accompanied by a strong smell.

The material is reasonably resistant and won't break apart too easily.

equipment.name: Old GP-4 Gas Mask
equipment.description:
This widespread Gas Mask was issued to Civil Defense and civilians alike, during the times of War. 

Vultures and Bandits often wear these for days at a time, and the mask’s straps dig themselves painfully into the back of their heads.

This one is on the brink of shattering completely, rendering it mostly ineffective.

equipment.name: Old Kepka
equipment.description:
An old relic of pre-War times, when caps like this were fashionable among students and workers alike.

This one is very beat-up and on the cusp of dissolving into thin air, but still offers some warmth.

equipment.name: Old Tactical Pants
equipment.description: A pair of beat-up tactical pants worn by the armed men of pre-War times. Offers great mobility and is pretty comfortable, but doesn't protect against the rocky terrain of the wastes.

equipment.name: Old Tactical Vest
equipment.description:
A beat-up tactical vest worn by police forces of pre-Mist times. It offers great mobility and decent protection against weaker types of weapon fire.

This vest is usually a reward for those with basic training and experience in the field.

equipment.name: Palatine Uniform
equipment.description: Bits of a standard-issue Palatine uniform, modeled after the War heroes of old.

equipment.name: Panskiy Kask
equipment.description:
An old aviator's helmet, with stellar wind protection and decent resistance against impact.

However, it's a bit uncomfortable to wear all day long, and it dulls the senses a bit - not ideal for the field.

equipment.name: Parade Helmet
equipment.description: A high-quality steel helmet, mass-produced during the War. A red star was painted on it at some point; anyone who would've known what it means is long gone.

equipment.name: Patched Armored Blouse
equipment.description:
A decayed padding meant to be fastened and worn on top of one’s shirt, consisting of bits and pieces of ceramic and ballistic nylon, strung together haphazardly. 

This abomination of a vest could only take a couple shots before becoming completely useless.

equipment.name: Patched Pants
equipment.description:
Old, raggedy pants, held together by haphazard patches. They offer some warmth where there aren't any holes.

Even sitting in the rubble of Zalesye will hurt your legs when all you have is this.

equipment.name: Plated Overcoat
equipment.description: A quality overcoat with some extra armor plating on the shoulder. The preferred gear for most scavengers, as it's very resistant to weather and the mud and grime of Zalesye.

equipment.name: Plated Ragged Pants
equipment.description: A pair of blue pants with defensive platings, tactical pouches and worn out cuffs. A bit difficult to move around in, but sturdy enough.

equipment.name: Rada Outfit
equipment.description: Clothes from a working Rada member, stained with sweat from hard work at the farms.

equipment.name: Rain Coat
equipment.description: An old, discarded rain coat that can offer plenty of protection from the constant rains of Zalesye, at the cost of providing very little warmth.

equipment.name: Refurbished Kask
equipment.description: A refurbished helmet from the War, unbalanced and clunky but with decent protection against impact and, with luck, capable of resisting a couple of bullets.

equipment.name: Reinforced Leather Pants
equipment.description:
A creased pair of leather pants with bits of scrap metal sewn into the knees.
Useful for the ever-kneeling scavengers as they search for more comfortable armor.

equipment.name: Revolutionary Kepka
equipment.description:
An old relic of pre-War times, when caps like this were fashionable among students and workers alike.

The pristine condition of this cap is a testament to the strength of ideals that are lost on you.

equipment.name: Riot Vest
equipment.description: This extra-sturdy, plated armor seems good enough to hold back a crowd of people, and even withstand some fire. It is heavy and difficult to wear, but survival is worth a little struggle.

equipment.name: Ruined Beret
equipment.description:
Once a classy beret worn by the upper ranks of the pre-War military, now a repulsive piece of headwear that is barely holding together.

A good fit for Zalesye.

equipment.name: Scrapyard Armor
equipment.description:
A large piece of armor plating strapped onto good-quality clothes, offering a mix of warmth and protection.

A reasonable balance between defense and mobility for those with a low budget.

equipment.name: Scrapyard Pants
equipment.description: A pair of old pants that's been fitted with armor platings and readjusted to prevent it from falling apart. Offers decent protection.

equipment.name: Security Helmet
equipment.description: A reinforced metal helmet with an armored visor, designed for heavy-duty security work. Offers great protection, but is exhaustive to wear for long periods.

equipment.name: Skull Mask
equipment.description: A menacing mask in the shape of a skull, worn by different folks for different reasons: some in respect and awe of the dead, others in order to intimidate and scare.

equipment.name: Stronghold Vest
equipment.description:
A souped-up tactical vest, with shoulder guards and bits of metal woven in throughout the fabric. Offers good protection from weaker weapons, at the cost of mobility.

This combat-oriented vest is usually worn by those have proven themselves capable.

equipment.name: Vozhd Beret
equipment.description:
A classy beret meant to be casually worn by the upper ranks of the pre-War military.

Its dignity and style is unlikely to be conveyed in the muddy pits of the Mire.

equipment.name: Vulture Wear
equipment.description: Clothes from a Vulture. You have to scrap the mud off to feel the cloth.

equipment.name: Winter Pants
equipment.description: A pair of thick, ragged pants with numerous patches; made by survivalists who don't mind a little extra sweat.
